code:
# Obsidian workspace state; changes on every open/close, no information value
.obsidian/workspace.json
.obsidian/workspace-mobile.json

# Graph layout cache; large, regenerated automatically
.obsidian/graph.json

# Plugin-generated caches
.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-git/data.json.bak
.obsidian/.trash/

# OS noise
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
description: A minimal .gitignore that keeps noisy, auto-regenerated vault files out of GitHub: workspace state, caches, and OS noise.

steps.description: This is a `.gitignore` for an Obsidian vault. The first section ignores workspace state. The comment says these change on every open and close and carry no information value, so `workspace.json` and `workspace-mobile.json` stay out of version control.
The second section ignores the graph layout cache, `graph.json`. The comment calls it large and regenerated automatically.
The third section ignores plugin-generated caches: the git plugin's `data.json.bak` and the `.trash/` directory.
The last section ignores OS noise: `.DS_Store` and `Thumbs.db`, the files your operating system creates on its own.

title: A .gitignore for Obsidian Vaults
